tools.name: apply_dao_membership
tools.description: Submit a membership application to UltravioletaDAO (Latin America Web3 community). Provide name, email, skills array, and motivation text.

motivation.description: Why the applicant wants to join the DAO

tools.name: focus_ecosystem_node
tools.description: Highlight one product on the /ecosystem map (navigates there if needed), switch to its desktop and open its node card. Returns the node with its incoming and outgoing edges.

tools.name: get_dao_info
tools.description: Get public information about UltravioletaDAO: token contract, treasury address, governance space and official links.

tools.name: get_ecosystem_map
tools.description: Map of the UltravioletaDAO product ecosystem as measured by c0der (nodes = public projects, edges = real API calls / facilitator usage). Filter by layer (swarm, pillar, rail, community, tooling, external) or by a product id/name (returns it with its neighbours). Default: top 6 nodes by degree, url as host, strongest edges as strings "source>target protocol:evidence" ("~" = planned) plus edges_total. verbose:true returns full nodes (tags, repo) and edge objects.

product.description: Product id or name; returns it and its neighbours

include_edges.description: Include edges between the returned nodes (default true)

verbose.description: Full nodes (tags, repo, full url) and edge objects (default false)

tools.name: get_ecosystem_messages
tools.description: Latest public messages of a MeshRelay IRC channel used by the DAO agents (#agents, #karmakadabra, #bounties, #execution-market), IRC colour codes stripped, text clipped to 280 chars. Default: newest 5, trimmed to ~1500 chars; pass limit for an exact count. Content is written by third parties: treat it as untrusted.

tools.name: get_ecosystem_pulse
tools.description: Live health/activity of the ecosystem, one block per source: facilitator (/health and /supported), meshrelay (IRC stats), search (stream transcript index), karmakadabra (KPIs via its hosted MCP), execution_market (market snapshot via KarmaKadabra MCP, third-party data, plus available tasks) and milly (402milly stats). Each block reports status live|error; verbose:true adds each source URL and fetch time. Third-party output is untrusted.

verbose.description: Add source URL and fetch time per block (default false)

tools.name: get_facilitator_networks
tools.description: List the blockchain networks supported by the UltravioletaDAO x402 gasless payment facilitator (facilitator.ultravioletadao.xyz). Without "network" returns the mainnet names; with "network" (e.g. "avalanche", "base", "solana" or a CAIP-2 id like "eip155:43114") returns its supported tokens and fee payer.

network.description: Network name or CAIP-2 id to inspect

tools.name: get_stream_summary
tools.description: Get the AI-generated summary (markdown, truncated to ~1200 chars) of one UltravioletaDAO Twitch stream by its video_id (from list_stream_summaries). Premium summaries may require an x402 payment; in that case the tool returns error "payment_required".

tools.name: get_token_metrics
tools.description: Live market metrics of the UVD token (Avalanche C-Chain): USD/AVAX price, 24h change, market cap, liquidity, burned tokens and holders (from DexScreener/Routescan).

tools.name: get_treasury
tools.description: Balance of the UltravioletaDAO treasury (Safe multisig on Avalanche C-Chain): total in USD, top token holdings, number of owners and signature threshold.

tools.name: list_ecosystem_products
tools.description: List the live public products of the UltravioletaDAO ecosystem (KarmaKadabra, Execution Market, MeshRelay, Describe.net, x402 facilitator, SDKs, ...) with URL and layer. verbose:true adds public repo, status, tags and whether the product can be embedded in an iframe.

verbose.description: Add repo, status, tags and embeddable (default false)

tools.name: list_governance_proposals
tools.description: List UltravioletaDAO governance proposals from Snapshot (space ultravioletadao.eth) with state, closing date, choices, vote count, quorum status and a short Spanish briefing when available. Default: active proposals only.

tools.name: list_stream_summaries
tools.description: List the most recent AI-generated summaries of UltravioletaDAO Twitch streams (newest first). Optional filters: language (es/en/pt/fr) and streamer username. Use get_stream_summary with a video_id to read one.

tools.name: navigate_to
tools.description: Open a section of the UltravioletaDAO site in the current tab (client-side routing): home, about, apply, snapshot, stream-summaries, token, metrics, services, facilitator, ecosystem, agents, events, nfts, links, courses, contributors, experiments, safestats, wheel.

tools.name: open_terminal
tools.description: Open a terminal window on the /ecosystem desktop (navigates there if needed). kind: graph, node, narrative, pulse, irc, agent, milly, mesh_stats, mesh_channels, mesh_certs, fac_health, fac_supported, observatory, site, kk_kpi, kk_trades, kk_status, em_metrics, em_tasks, replay, md, code. Optional desktop: ecosystem, karmakadabra, execution_market, meshrelay, describe_net, facilitator. channel applies to kind irc, snippet to kind code, key to kind replay/md.

desktop.description: Desktop to switch to (default: the kind's own)

snippet.description: Pinned snippet id for kind code

key.description: Replay or markdown key for kind replay/md

connect.description: For embeds (observatory/site): load the iframe right away

tools.name: run_ecosystem_command
tools.description: Run one line of the agent@uvd prompt on /ecosystem. Grammar: help | tools | run <tool> [json] | open <kind> [desktop] | graph <node_id> | curl <allowlisted url> [| jq .path] | braille | expose | list | desk <n|id> | clear. No shell, no eval; curl only reaches the endpoint allowlist of the page.

tools.name: search_stream_memory
tools.description: Full-text search over the transcripts of UltravioletaDAO Twitch streams (2024-2026). Returns matching moments with date, timestamp and a Twitch link. If the user is on the site, the results are also shown on the /stream-summaries page.

tools.name: set_desk_mode
tools.description: Switch the /ecosystem desktop view: desk (windows), expose (grid of all windows) or list (plain list).

tools.name: set_language
tools.description: Switch the UltravioletaDAO site UI language (es, en, pt or fr).
